findings.title: Call to non-existent no-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added to its superclass UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) at UsernamePasswordForm.java:160. No no-arg overload exists in UsernamePasswordForm, AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator, or elsewhere in the changed code, so this file fails compilation and the whole services module cannot build.

findings.title: Passkey form data is no longer populated on the initial login page
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) now requires user != null, and authenticate() at line 115 uses it as the only gate for webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context). On a first (non-re-authentication) login context.getUser() is null precisely because the user has not been identified yet, which is the discoverable/passkey-autofill case conditional UI exists for. Previously fillContextForm was called in the user==null branch. The new code therefore renders the initial username/password page without challenge/RP/conditional-UI attributes and without the webauthn form, breaking passwordless discoverable-key login from UsernamePasswordForm (existing tests such as webauthnLoginWithDiscoverableKey and passwordLoginWithExternalKey expect the webauthn form on the first page). The same inverted gate in challenge(error,field) at line 137 drops passkey data from error pages when no user is set. The fix should populate conditional-UI data both when no user is identified yet and when a user is re-authenticating, not flip from one to the other.

findings.title: Re-authentication skip is disabled for all users when realm passkeys are enabled, even users with no passkey
findings.body: Assuming the intended check is the realm-level isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()), it only tests that passkeys are enabled for the realm and a user is present; it never checks that this user actually has a passwordless WebAuthn credential. Consequently, during re-authentication (e.g. prompt=login) in the split UsernameForm+PasswordForm flow, users who previously were silently skipped through UsernameForm because they have no linked IdP will now always be stopped at the username form, even though they cannot use a passkey and must manually submit the (hidden-username) form to reach the password step. This is a behaviour regression for non-passkey users in passkey-enabled realms; the skip should only be suppressed when the current user could actually authenticate with a passkey.
